info.name: Golblick: 360 photo previews
info.summary: Timeline thumbnails for 360 camera files that Nextcloud cannot otherwise see
info.description:
Shows Insta360 `.insp` photos as levelled panoramas instead of a generic icon in Files and Memories.
The camera stores the two lenses' fisheye images rather than a panorama, so this app builds the panorama in plain PHP using GD, which Nextcloud already requires. No new server-side dependency, and no external programs.
⚠️ Needs `"insp": ["image/jpeg"]` added to `config/mimetypemapping.json`, which has side effects. Read the README before installing. The app's admin settings page can add it for you, and checks the rest of the setup.
info.author: Akshay Rao
